=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:3120-3131 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: On an unseeded tick (a free lease, no priority-lane PRs and an empty or unread merge-train queue), `_MT_LEASE_RUNS_STATE` is "" when `_mt_merge_lease_ready_final_ci` runs, so it logs `RELEASE_GATE_FINAL_CI_HOLD outcome=runs_unread` and passes an empty `PR_FINAL_CI_RELEASE_GATE_RUNS_JSON`. The hold block in `_pr_ensure_final_ci` (scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:1418-1421) is then skipped, and the ~45-job full final CI is dispatched while a release gate is active.
  WHY: The tick clears the cache at 2143-2146 when it was not seeded. It is filled only at 1856-1858, at 1943-1946 (holder paths 2277/2308/2732/2759) and at 3438-3452, so the step-3 dispatch at 2494-2496 runs uncovered. This breaks the acceptance line "With a release gate active, the merge-lease tick does not dispatch a new full final CI". The tests cover only seeded ticks. Both reviewers rated it MAJOR.
- scripts/review_final_ci_sweep.sh:536 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The review sweep calls `_pr_ensure_final_ci "${REPOSITORY}" "${number}" "${sha}" "${ref}"` without `PR_FINAL_CI_RELEASE_GATE_RUNS_JSON`. A head the merge-lease tick deferred with release_gate_active has head-gate success and no final-CI run, so the sweep dispatches the same full final CI on its next tick without checking the gate.
  WHY: The hold only moves the 45-job dispatch from the lease tick to the next sweep tick, so runners are not kept free while the gate runs. The changelog line "merges stop starting full CI runs while a gate runs" overstates what ships. Rated MAJOR.
- scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh:1928-1937 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The per-tip cap `rc_tip_retries` counts only `[cycle-retry]` runs whose head_sha equals the newest cycle run's head_sha. Retries are dispatched with `--ref "${PROMOTE_CYCLE_DEFAULT_BRANCH}"` (main), so every time main advances the count restarts at 1 and never reaches `PROMOTE_CYCLE_GATE_CANCEL_RETRY_MAX`. Each new retry also resets rc_age, so the 24-hour window never closes.
  WHY: A runner pool that never clears can start an ~87-minute, ~10-job gate every hour while main moves, which defeats "so a pool that never clears cannot start a gate every hour". The tests use a fixed TIP. Severity disagreement: gemini, minimax and glm rated it MAJOR and sonnet rated it NIT; the highest is used.
- scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh:552-582 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In `gate_cancel_cause`, `if [ "${checked}" -ge 6 ]; then break; fi` leaves watch-step candidates unread without setting `read_failed`, so the function prints `other` instead of `unknown`.
  WHY: If the runner-wait self-cancel line is in the 7th or a later candidate (the gate has 7 recognised watch-step candidates), the cancel is recorded as `cause=other`, the marker step does not run and the poller does not retry. This contradicts the function's own header contract. Severity disagreement: gemini rated it MAJOR and the others NIT; the highest is used.
- scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh:promote_cycle_retry_check (rc_tip_retries jq filter) | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The cap counts every `[cycle-retry]` run on the tip, including runner_wait_long retries that were skipped before the smoke gate and never ran a gate.
  WHY: A tip with 3 runner_wait_long retries logs outcome=cap_reached on its first gate runner-wait cancel and dispatches nothing. The tip then falls back to the nightly cron, an 11-hour delay. Rated NIT.
- scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh:1869-1935 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The runs listing uses `per_page=20`, but the cap accepts values 1-99 (lines 357-360), so caps above 20 cannot be enforced.
  WHY: With `PROMOTE_CYCLE_GATE_CANCEL_RETRY_MAX=21` and more than 20 retries for one tip, `rc_tip_retries` stays at 20 or below and dispatching continues. Rated NIT. glm made the related per_page undercount point as a hardening suggestion only.
- scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh:571 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: minimax claims that `( |\$)` in the `RELEASE_GATE_RUNNER_WAIT outcome=cancel_requested gate_run=${run_id}` grep matches a literal `$` rather than end of line. It says the same pattern appears at scripts/review_merge_train.sh:2456 and 2927 (`(:|\$)`).
  WHY: If the producer ever omits the trailing fields, the line falls through to `cause=other`. Rated NIT. This is uncertain: sonnet and glm both checked it and rejected it, because inside double quotes the shell turns `\$` into `$`, which grep reads as an end-of-line anchor.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "With a release gate active, the merge-lease tick does not dispatch a new full final CI and logs why; with no gate active the dispatch is unchanged." Change 3 adds: "If the plan finds that change 2 cannot be made without a new per-tick API call or without slowing merges outside a gate, implement change 1 alone and say so in the PR body with the evidence."
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_merge_train.sh `_mt_merge_lease_ready_final_ci` (around line 3120) and the tick's active-run cache seeding, plus the multi-holder call site at line 3003, or else the PR body
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The cache is never filled on this path (agents.d/10266-gate-cancel-retry-final-ci-hold.md: "the cache is never filled for it"). The tick clears `_MT_LEASE_RUNS_STATE`/`_MT_LEASE_RUNS_JSON` at review_merge_train.sh:2143-2146. `_mt_release` seeds the cache only at 3423-3449 for queued merge-train PRs, and `_mt_lease_pr_runs_active` (2277, 2308, 2732, 2759) runs only on holder paths. Unseeded ticks therefore reach lines 3120-3125, log `runs_unread` and dispatch (free-lease step-3 path at 2495). test_ready_final_ci_passes_tick_run_cache_for_gate_hold locks in the bypass ("rc=0 held=0 outcome=dispatched"). The PR description neither discloses the partial coverage nor gives the narrowing evidence change 3 requires. Nothing stops the review sweep from dispatching the deferred head. A lazy fill (`_mt_lease_pr_runs_active` or `_mt_inflight_review_branches` + `_mt_lease_runs_seed`) could reuse the tick's existing listing budget (review_merge_train.sh:2141 comment).
- requirement: "add a cap per tip (default 3, new variable with a default, §4) so a pool that never clears cannot start a gate every hour" (issue #10266, Changes item 1)
  expected_change_site: scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh `promote_cycle_retry_check` (per-tip retry counting)
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The cap exists and is wired (scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh:355-361, 1929-1936; .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:2162), but retries dispatched with `--ref main` adopt a new head_sha whenever main advances, which resets the count to 1 each hour.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:3120-3125 (_mt_merge_lease_ready_final_ci; related 2143-2146, 1943-1946, 3438-3452) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The hold works only when the tick's active-run cache was filled earlier in the tick. On a free lease with an empty merge-train queue, the step-3 dispatch (2494-2496) sees state "", logs runs_unread and passes an empty PR_FINAL_CI_RELEASE_GATE_RUNS_JSON. pr_checks_lib.sh line 1421 then skips the hold, and the 45-job suite is dispatched.
  WHY: This breaks the acceptance line "With a release gate active, the merge-lease tick does not dispatch a new full final CI". test_seeded_tick_gate_hold_tries_no_later_waiter sets _MT_LEASE_RUNS_SEEDED=1 and never covers the unseeded path.
- scripts/review_final_ci_sweep.sh:536 (with scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh _pr_ensure_final_ci, hold block lines 1418-1446) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The sweep calls _pr_ensure_final_ci without PR_FINAL_CI_RELEASE_GATE_RUNS_JSON. It picks up exactly the heads the lease tick deferred with release_gate_active ("dispatch no_run" at review_merge_train.sh:3119).
  WHY: The hold only moves the dispatch to the next sweep tick, so runners are not kept free for the gate. The changelog overstates what ships.
- scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh:promote_cycle_retry_check, rc_tip_retries jq filter | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The cap counts every [cycle-retry] run on the tip, including runner_wait_long retries that never ran a gate.
  WHY: 3 runner_wait_long retries make the first gate runner-wait cancel log outcome=cap_reached. The tip then falls back to the nightly cron, an 11-hour delay.
- scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh:promote_cycle_retry_check, rc_head/rc_tip_retries per-head_sha count with `--ref "${PROMOTE_CYCLE_DEFAULT_BRANCH}"` dispatch | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: When main moves between retries, head_sha changes and rc_tip_retries restarts at 1. Each new retry also resets rc_age, so the 24-hour window never closes.
  WHY: The poller can start a self-cancelling gate (87 minutes, about 10 jobs) every hour without limit. The runner-wait check is the only bound, and it read "clear" at start in the 2026-11-28 incident.
- scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh:gate_cancel_cause, `if [ "${checked}" -ge 6 ]; then break; fi` | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: When more than 6 cancelled jobs sit in watch steps, the loop stops with candidates unread and prints other, which contradicts the function's contract.
  WHY: A real runner-wait self-cancel in the 7th or a later job is recorded as cause=other, so there is no marker step and no retry. Setting read_failed="true" before the break would fix it.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "With a release gate active, the merge-lease tick does not dispatch a new full final CI and logs why", plus change 3 (implement change 1 alone and say so in the PR body with evidence) | Expected change site: scripts/review_merge_train.sh _mt_merge_lease_ready_final_ci, or the PR body | Evidence of absence: the cache is never filled for this path (agents.d/10266-gate-cancel-retry-final-ci-hold.md); unseeded ticks log runs_unread and dispatch; the PR description does not disclose the partial coverage; nothing stops the sweep from dispatching the deferred head | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
- HARDENING (2 related items, HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2): (1) in gate_cancel_cause, set read_failed="true" before the `checked -ge 6` break (1 line). (2) In tests/test_promote_main_cycle.py, assert that each watch-step name and the "Dispatch & watch — " prefix appears as a "- name:" in .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml (lines 2024, 4014/4112/4200, 4405, 4877, 5513) (6 lines).
- NOTE: This reviewer rejected the pass-1 claim that `( |\$)` matches a literal `$`. In double quotes, grep receives `( |$)`.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh:1928-1933 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `rc_tip_retries` counts only runs with the same `head_sha`. Retries dispatched with `--ref main` create a new tip, so `(.head_sha // "") == $head` never matches earlier retries.
  WHY: The per-tip cap is never reached, which allows unlimited retries of a self-cancelled smoke gate while the runner pool stays wedged.
- scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh:558-562 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `gate_cancel_cause` loop breaks after 6 attempts and prints `other`
